content_sections.heading: CSL PMIS Internship 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: CSL shall be posting the vacancies through the PMIS portal from time to time. Candidates are encouraged to visit the PMIS portal periodically. Last Date: 30-10-2026

content_sections.heading: CSL PMIS Internship 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 227 internship seats are available across six qualification categories: ITI Trades, SSLC, HSE/ITI, Diploma, Graduation, and Post Graduation. The notification states that the number of seats is based on existing requirement and may vary depending on future requirements.

content_sections.heading: CSL PMIS Internship 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility varies by category, based on the educational qualification corresponding to each set of trades/disciplines listed above. Age Limit: 18 to 25 years, applicable across all categories. Candidates from technical trade backgrounds can also check the latest ITI Jobs and Internships 2026 for more openings.

rows.educational_qualification: Pass in Xth standard AND Pass in ITI (National Trade Certificate - NTC)
Pass in XIIth standard / ITI (National Trade Certificate - NTC)

A Diploma in Engineering or Technology in the relevant discipline, granted by a State Council/Board of Technical Education, a University, or an institution recognized as equivalent by the State or Central Government
Graduation (other than performing arts/B.Tech) - BA/BSc/BCom/BBA/BCA, etc.

content_sections.heading: CSL PMIS Internship 2026 Ineligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The following categories of candidates are not eligible to apply under this scheme: Graduates/Postgraduates from IITs, IIMs, National Law Universities, IISER, NIDs, IIITs, and IISc. Candidates holding qualifications such as CA, CMA, CS, MBBS, BDS, MD, MS, MBA or equivalent, MPhil, and PhD. Candidates already undergoing any skill, apprenticeship, internship, or training program under Central or State Government schemes. Candidates who have completed apprenticeship or training under the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) or National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS) at any point. Candidates whose family income exceeds ₹12 lakh in the preceding financial year, as on the date of submission of application. Candidates with any family member who is a permanent/regular government employee.

content_sections.heading: CSL PMIS Internship 2026 Stipend
content_sections.text: ITI Trades, SSLC, and HSE/ITI categories: ₹11,000 per month (including Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) by the Government of India) Diploma, Graduation, and Post Graduation categories: ₹13,000 per month (including Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) by the Government of India) No travel expenses are admissible for attending certificate verification or during the internship training period. Boarding and lodging will not be provided by CSL during the internship period.

content_sections.heading: CSL PMIS Internship 2026 Duration
content_sections.text: The duration of the internship will be Nine (9) months, as per the Prime Minister Internship Scheme guidelines.

content_sections.heading: CSL PMIS Internship 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: There is no application fee for the CSL PMIS Internship 2026. The notification explicitly states "Application Fee: Nil."

content_sections.heading: CSL PMIS Internship 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Shortlisting of candidates will be based on the percentage of marks obtained in the prescribed qualification applicable to the respective trade/discipline. In case two or more candidates secure the same percentage of marks, relative merit will be decided based on seniority in age. Shortlisted candidates will be issued an offer of Internship Training through the PMIS portal and must appear for certificate verification on the date mentioned in the offer letter. Certificate verification requires original certificates for proof of age, qualification, caste, and disability (if any), along with self-attested copies of the same. On successful completion of certificate verification, candidates will be provisionally inducted for internship training, subject to medical fitness.

content_sections.heading: CSL PMIS Internship 2026 Documents Required
content_sections.text: Original certificates as proof of age Original educational qualification certificates relevant to the applied category Original caste certificate (if applicable) Original disability certificate (if applicable) Self-attested copies of all the above documents Equivalency Certificate, if the candidate holds a qualification equivalent to the prescribed qualification, issued by the competent authority

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSL PMIS Internship 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official PMIS Portal at https://pminternship.mca.gov.in/login/ . Go through the Candidate User Manual published on the PMIS portal (Manuals section) before filing the online application. Register and fill out the online application form, ensuring that marks and other details are entered accurately. Submit the application through the PMIS Portal. Frequently check the PMIS portal for updates related to shortlisting and selection, as offer letters will not be sent by post.

faq.question: Q1. What is CSL PMIS Internship 2026?
faq.answer: It is a notification from Cochin Shipyard Limited inviting online applications for engagement of interns under the Prime Minister Internship Scheme (PMIS) for a period of 9 months, across ITI, SSLC, HSE/ITI, Diploma, Graduation, and Post Graduation categories.

faq.question: Q2. How many seats are available under CSL PMIS Internship 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 227 seats are available (computed from the category-wise figures in the notification), though the notification states the number of seats may vary depending on future requirements.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for CSL PMIS Internship 2026?
faq.answer: No fixed last date has been specified. CSL will post vacancies through the PMIS portal from time to time, and candidates are advised to check the portal periodically.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for CSL PMIS Internship 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification requirements vary by category - from a pass in Xth standard with ITI (NTC) for ITI Trades, up to MA Hindi/MA Hindi with Translation for the Post Graduation category. Refer to the eligibility table for category-specific requirements.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for CSL PMIS Internship 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 25 years, applicable uniformly across all categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for CSL PMIS Internship 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee. The notification states "Application Fee: Nil."

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for CSL PMIS Internship 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply only through the official PMIS Portal at https://pminternship.mca.gov.in/login/ after going through the Candidate User Manual available on the portal.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for CSL PMIS Internship 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on shortlisting by percentage of marks in the prescribed qualification, followed by certificate verification, and provisional induction subject to medical fitness.

faq.question: Q9. What is the stipend for CSL PMIS Internship 2026?
faq.answer: The stipend is ₹11,000 per month for ITI Trades, SSLC, and HSE/ITI categories, and ₹13,000 per month for Diploma, Graduation, and Post Graduation categories, including Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) by the Government of India.

faq.question: Q10. Does the CSL PMIS Internship guarantee a job at Cochin Shipyard after completion?
faq.answer: No. As per the notification, CSL has no obligation to offer employment upon completion of the internship, and an intern cannot claim any right to employment on the grounds of completing the internship.
